verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows user-configurable automations, such as rules, triggers, or recurring scheduled actions, that run unattended. Built-in AI auto-labeling and junk filtering are fixed product behaviors, not automations a user sets up. The MCP server acts only when the user asks, and the REST API is a developer building block, so neither counts as a background automation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
